project-house.src:
tracy = Turtle()

def wall():
    for i in range(4):
        tracy.forward(100)
        tracy.left(90)

def roof():
    tracy.left(90)
    tracy.forward(100)
    tracy.right(90)
    for i in range(3):
        tracy.forward(100)
        tracy.left(120)

def door():
    for i in range(2):
        tracy.forward(20)
        tracy.left(90)
        tracy.forward(40)
        tracy.left(90)

wall()
roof()
tracy.penup()
tracy.setposition(40, 0)
tracy.setheading(0)
tracy.pendown()
door()
tracy.penup()
tracy.setposition(65, 60)
tracy.pendown()
for i in range(4):
    tracy.forward(20)
    tracy.left(90)
